decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Any areas of external brickwork/paintwork.masonry required to be created/replaced in accrodance with the approved plans shall match the existing brickwork/paintwork.masonry in brick colour and size, mortar colour and pointing and bonding detail.

Condition : 4 - The wall coverings, plaster etc shall be carefully stripped to reveal any underlying timber frame that may exist, in addition to that which is already visible. If any further timber framework is found no part shall be cut or removed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 6 - The smoke detectors, fire alarm call points, fire alarms, emergency lighting fittings and control boxes shall be located in unobtrusive positions in the corners of rooms and their electrical cabling systems shall not be surface mounted but concealed within the floors, ceilings and walls, except where otherwise approved, and the walls, floors and ceilings made good to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 7 - Details of the urns to be used on the gate piers, including samples if so required, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Listed Building consent for the repair of fire damage to the ground floor, first floor and main stairwell, installation of fire and security alarms. Installation of lighting and electrical sockets on ground floor and first floor and improvements in DDA provision to single storey wing and garden.
